name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Pear Champagne
description: Pop the flavor with Pear Champagne BITEZ Gummies. These double-stacked treats layer crisp, juicy pear with sparkling champagne sweetness for a bright, sophisticated flavor with a celebratory finish. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). Consider this your VIP pass to a flavor worth celebrating.
